Shortage of universities in the country
*341. SHRI C. PERUMAL: Will the
Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether universities are less in
number in our country as compared to
China, where there are 900 universities
and Japan where there are 4000
universities;
(b) if so, whether it is proposed to
increase the number of universities in the
country;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Tribals residing in forest lands
*342. SHRI MATILAL SARKAR:
Will the Minister of TRIBAL AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) the number of Tribal families
residing in the forest lands in different
States, for which they have not been given
the order of settlement;
(b) whether these families are allowed
to use the non-timber forest produces for
their livelihood;
(c) whether Government propose to
give these families the right to the forest in
consideration of their age-old adaptation
to the forest-life; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?

 SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA:
Will the Minister of WOMEN AND

(b) the total number of anganwadi
workers and helpers working in the
country;

month to anganwadi workers and helpers;
and

Eviction of tribals due to dam projects
*344. SHRI V. HANUMANTHA
RAO: Will the Minister of TRIBAL
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that nearly 10
lakh tribals will be up-rooted and evicted
from forest in the next 24 months due to
various projects, dams, industries etc.;
(b) to what extent will the tribal culture
and tribal ethos be affected by such eviction
on a mass scale;
(c) whether it is a fact that Government
have no plan or policy to ensure that tribal
eviction and tribal homelessness is not
equal to progress; and
(d) the steps proposed to ban all tribal
eviction for five years?
Pitiable state of Indian universities
*345. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: Will the Minister of
HUMAN RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Indian
universities are in pitiable state;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether it is also a fact that they are
unable to perform and compete with their
research contribution coming down to an
all-time low;
(d) the reasons for such under-
performance and incompetence in research
contribution in our country;
(e) the steps Government have taken
during the last two years to compete with
the international standards; and
(f) the steps Government would like to
take to strengthen the whole university
system in future within a specific time-
frame?
Financing of mega power projects by
ADB
*346. SHRI B.J. PANDA:
MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government plan to rope
in the Asian Development Bank (ADB) for
financing five ultra mega power plants of
4,000 MW each to boost the confidence of
private developers etc.;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether any of such plant is located
in Orissa; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Amount required for research and
development of mineral wealth
†*347. SHRI AJAY MAROO: Will the
Minister of MINES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is a
need of Rs. 2500 crores every year for
research and development of mineral
wealth of India;
(b) the amount being spent on this work
at present every year; and
(c) the future plan of Government in this
regard?
Amount for research institutes of CSIR
*348. SHRI S. ANBALAGAN: Will
the Minister of SCIENCE AND
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) the amount allocated for each of the
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

research institutes of CSIR during each of
the last three years;
(b) the amount spent by them alongwith
the percentage of amount spent for
research, institute-wise;
(c) whether it is fact that research output
is almost insignificant when compared to
the administrative and infrastructural
expenses incurred on these institutes; and
(d) if so, the justification for continuous
huge expenditure in this regard?

Amount for development of NER
†2414. SHRI JAI PARKASH
AGGARWAL: Will the Minister of
DEVELOPMENT OF NORTH
EASTERN REGION be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the amount allocated
for development of North-Eastern region
as on date;
(b) whether the pace of development
works in N.E. States is slow despite
formation of a separate Ministry for
development of North-Eastern Region; and
(c) whether Centre has taken bay
measures to expedite various projects meant
for North-Eastern States?
Financial packages by Government
2415. SHRI SITARAM YECHURY:
Will the Minister of DEVELOPMENT OF
NORTH EASTERN REGION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the promises
made by Government in terms of
investment are not materialising in the
proposed period of time;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) the details of financial packages
announced by various Governments in the
last 10 years and the actual financial
assistance rendered to the region by the
Centre?
Utilization of funds allocated to NEC
2416. SHRI LALHMING LIANA: Will
the Minister of DEVELOPMENT OF
NORTH EASTERN REGION be pleased
to state:
(a) the total allocation of fund to the
North Eastern Council (NEC) during the
Tenth Plan and the details of the utilization
of the fund, including State-wise share of
the Tenth Plan Fund; and
(b) the percentage of increase/decrease
of the Eleventh Five Year Plan allocation to
the NEC?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

558
Enquiry by National Institute of
Oceanography into the sea surge
2417. SHRI V. HANUMANTHA
RAO: Will the Minister of EARTH
SCIENCES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the National
Institute of Oceanography enquired of the
"Sea Surge" along the Visakhapatnam coast
on 27th July, 2006;
(b) if so, the findings of the National
Institute of Oceanography into the frequent
sea surges in that area;
(c) whether the NIO has made any
suggestions to prevent erosion of sand in
that area; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Consumption of fruits and vegetable
products
2418. SHRIMATI MOHSINA
KIDWAI:
SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
Will the Minister of FOOD
PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that consumption
of value added fruits and vegetable products
is low compared to primary processed food
in general and fresh fruits and vegetables in
particular which is attributed to higher
incidence of tax and duties including that
on packaging material, lower capacity
utilization, non-adoption of cost effective
technology, high cost of finance,
infrastructural constraints, inadequate
farmer-processors linkage leading to
dependence upon intermediaries; and
(b) if so, the remedial action
Government propose to take in this regard?
Misleading advertisements on
substandard food products
2419. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of  FOOD PROCESSING
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the fact that a lot of misleading
advertisements appear in the electronic and
print media about substandard food
products;
(b) the steps taken to prevent
publication of such advertisements; and
(c) whether Government would
consider to appoint a separate Board for
viewing such advertisements before their
telecast or publication?
Fruits and vegetables for processing
2420. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of  FOOD PROCESSING
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the fruits
and vegetables consumed for processing is
only about 2.2 per cent;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the major
Indian fruits and vegetables used for
processing; and
(c) the steps taken to increase
production of fruits and vegetables for food
processing?
Paper on Indian food processing
industry
2421. SHRI C. PERUMAL: Will the
Minister of FOOD PROCESSING
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Association of Chamber of
Commerce and Industry has submitted a
paper on Indian food processing industry;

559
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether any steps have been taken
to implement the recommendation;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Competition in food processing
industry
2422. SHRI SYED AZEEZ PASHA:
Will the Minister of FOOD PROCESSING
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state whether
Government have taken sufficient steps in
view of the international competition in
the food processing area because we could
not imagine modern day competition in the
age of globalization without proper
upliftment of the food processing industry?
Q
